definition: Request from an employee → internal docs, wikis and policies → a grounded, source-cited answer; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only.
Request from a customer, in chat or voice → their own records plus product and policy documents → an answer, or an escalation carrying the context; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only.

Request from a technician or engineer, including through an AR camera → manuals, schematics, drawings and past project archives → guided steps or matching prior records; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only.

Continuous scan of a live call → running transcript plus account context → suggested wording, lookups and next-best action for the employee; human gate: before the action — the employee acts; agent acts: retrieval only.

Continuous scan of a live meeting or visit → speech and its context → a structured draft note with decisions and follow-ups; human gate: before the action — review and sign-off; agent acts: drafts an artifact.
Request naming one company or entity → external filings, news and registries plus internal records → a cited dossier or briefing; human gate: none — the reader decides; agent acts: retrieval only.

An event or a batch sweep opens a case → evidence assembled across systems and documents → an evidence file with a draft finding; human gate: before the action — a person decides the outcome; agent acts: retrieval only.

Request arriving as a structured document (RFP, questionnaire) → approved answer library and past bids → a compliant first draft with gaps flagged; human gate: before the action — experts close gaps; agent acts: drafts an artifact.
Schedule → governed internal data and external signals → a recurring narrative brief with the numbers, anomalies and sources behind them; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only.
Request asked in plain language → a governed schema, single-source or federated across systems and clouds → numbers and charts back, no report request; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only.

Request posing a what-if → curated data, with code the agent writes and runs → scenarios and their assumptions compared side by side; human gate: none; agent acts: retrieval only (runs code, no system written).

Schedule → a model trained on curated history, run over the whole population → a ranked list or a forecast with its drivers; human gate: before the action — a person decides and acts; agent acts: retrieval only.

Schedule, or an event that disrupts the plan → constraints, demand and capacity → the next period's operating plan (routes, shifts, pick paths) explained to the planner; human gate: before the action; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Event — a document arrives → its content read against schema and validation rules → structured fields written to the system of record; human gate: before the action, on exceptions; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Event — an item arrives → its topic, urgency and sentiment read → labelled and routed to the owning queue or handler; human gate: after the fact — the handler works it; agent acts: acts on systems of record (routing only).

Event — a document or record arrives → compared against a second governed reference (price list, policy, playbook, approved master) → a deviation list with evidence; human gate: before the action — a person acts; agent acts: retrieval only.

Event — a batch of items lands → each item summarised, translated or restructured at volume → a derived text set for people to use or analytics to consume; human gate: after the fact — spot-check; agent acts: drafts an artifact.

Event, request or continuous scan — an item arrives, an archive is searched, or live streams are watched → footage and images → indexed scenes, classifications or verified alerts with the clip; human gate: after the fact; agent acts: drafts an artifact.

Request carrying a brief → brand rules, product specifications and approved messaging → copy or assets that exist in no source, generated at volume; human gate: before the action — compliance or expert sign-off; agent acts: drafts an artifact.

Request from an employee, in chat or inside the application → entitlement and approval policy → a bounded transaction written to the system of record; human gate: before the action — approval or confirmation; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Request from a customer for a change → identity, entitlement and policy checks → the transaction executed with an audit trail, exceptions escalated; human gate: before the action — the customer confirms; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Queue item — a known exception type waiting to be worked → cross-system state investigated → the item fixed, or escalated with notes; human gate: after the fact — a person reads the note; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Event or request that starts a multi-week process → state, reminders and escalations held across systems → each step driven to completion and tracked; human gate: before the action — approvals at thresholds; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Event — an alert fires → logs, metrics, topology and recent deploys → a root-cause draft with a safe runbook fix, executed within guardrails; human gate: before the action, by risk policy; agent acts: acts on systems of record.

Event — a new vulnerability or security alert, or a scheduled intel refresh → asset inventory and threat data → a verdict with exposure and a patch or containment plan; human gate: before the action; agent acts: retrieval only.

Continuous scan of process data on a schedule → in-flight transactions, balances and SLAs → exceptions flagged with a suggested fix; human gate: before the action — a person approves; agent acts: retrieval only (the fix hands off to a task agent).
